title: Impact of Measured and Predicted Prosthesis-Patient Mismatch after Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement - Registry
summary: This study examines how prosthesis-patient mismatch (PPM) and other hemodynamic factors affects survival and treatment outcomes after transcatheter aortic valve implantation/replacement (TAVI/TAVR). PPM occurs when the implanted heart valve is too small relative to the patient’s body size. Both measured and predicted PPM values are analyzed. The goal is to determine the prevalence of PPM and to investigate whether it impacts survival, heart function, and other health factors. Patient data from 26 international centers treated with TAVI since 2006 are being evaluated.

interventions.name:
